note: Maids 1-5 talk to Motonari around the birth of his child (U00634-U00649); the child is not named, so 'the baby'.
Could be said before or after the birth (U00643-U00644 are pre-birth lines of the same maid); 'seems to be very healthy' works for both.
Choice limit 60 px. 'Don't let it go' is 69 px, so the refusal is 'Refuse' (35 px). Alt: 'Don't' (26 px).
The 'shady customer' is probably Motonari, but the Japanese keeps it impersonal; so does the English.

The Mouri and Kikkawa, on the Amago
side, besieged Kagamiyama Castle,
held by the Ouchi's Kurata Fusanobu.



In response, the Ouchi sent Amano
Okisada and Amano Takashige to
relieve Kagamiyama Castle.

en:
After this, Komatsumaru went to
the head-viewing ceremony, where
he found himself staring into the
dead eyes of the enemy general
Kurata Fusanobu. Overcome with
terror, he fell ill with the fever
called ague, in those days one of
the deadliest diseases...
